test_title: PYST 25: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven girls P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre, Q is third to the right of R. V is third to the right of P. T is to the immediate right of Q. S is to the immediate left of R. U is sitting between R and P. Who is sitting between S and T?
solution:
Seven girls P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Q is third to the right of R and T is to the immediate right of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0804aeff8ecabcdb14357a407bfe2e603b2eb42de885dc891b31e79677881b8d.png] 

2) S is to the immediate left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d99a4e875ed103039673d273a1b6c6b4889c2673f5e8e4239e3fd5694b469d2d.png] 

3) U is sitting between R and P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a74f0e642291b266bf505fba9da17bec833ab403c9a28f13b3f6e293c21d570.png] 

4) V is third to the right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/052ef67fce562fd48633f62692e4c36fbb17224dd77327d90af19eeb0a2458fc.png] 

Hence,** V** is sitting between S and T.
